facts.text: Threshold, zone and filter tuning should use grouped data partitions rather than random frame splits, holding out entire sites, weather episodes, machine IDs or scenario families.
facts.quote: Use grouped data partitions, not random frame splits. Hold out entire sites, weather episodes, machine IDs or scenario families.

facts.text: Adjacent frames from the same run appearing in both tuning and validation sets create severe data leakage.
facts.quote: Adjacent frames from the same run appearing in both tuning and validation sets create severe leakage.

facts.text: Threshold, zone and filter tuning should maintain a three-way data split: a development or tuning set, a validation or confirmation set, and an untouched audit (frozen test) set.
facts.quote: Keep a three-way split: development or tuning set, validation or confirmation set, and an untouched audit (frozen test) set.

facts.text: For machine-learning model and hyperparameter selection, nested cross-validation is the recognised way to remove the optimistic bias of repeated model selection.
facts.quote: For machine-learning model and hyperparameter selection, nested cross-validation is the recognised way to remove the optimistic bias of repeated model selection

facts.text: A three-way data split is the engineering analogue of nested cross-validation for removing the optimistic bias of repeated model selection.
facts.quote: nested cross-validation is the recognised way to remove the optimistic bias of repeated model selection; the engineering analogue is the three-way split.

facts.text: Threshold, zone and filter tuning should use nested validation across site types (leave-one-site-type-out) to test generalisation to unseen sites.
facts.quote: Use nested validation across site types (leave-one-site-type-out) to test generalisation to unseen sites.

facts.text: The frequency of queries to the frozen test set should be limited.
facts.quote: Limit how often the frozen test set is queried

facts.text: The frozen test set should be frozen at a version and refreshed only for a new release with a new frozen set.
facts.quote: freeze it at a version and refresh it only for a new release with a new frozen set.

facts.text: Tuned-set and frozen-set performance should be reported side by side.
facts.quote: Report tuned-set and frozen-set performance side by side

facts.text: A large gap between tuned-set and frozen-set performance signals over-fitting.
facts.quote: Report tuned-set and frozen-set performance side by side; a large gap signals over-fitting.
